name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting, spending countless hours tinkering with engines and fine-tuning performance. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Porto, focusing on advanced materials and computational fluid dynamics. After graduating, he joined a smaller racing team, rapidly progressing through the ranks to lead their technical department. 

Known for his meticulous approach and data-driven decision-making, Ricardo is constantly seeking marginal gains through innovative solutions. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their expertise. His dedication to pushing the boundaries of engineering makes him a valuable asset to Elite Motorsport, with a focus on reliability and sustainable performance gains. He is committed to leading the team to success through strategic planning and technical excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part.
physical.description: Ricardo has a lean build and a focused expression, often seen with a tablet in hand.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using only Portuguese coffee beans in the team's espresso machine.
